summary: Phase A UI cleanup testing complete. All major features verified: floating buttons removed from Pharmacy/Mango, inline action bar added to Pharmacy, toast notifications removed, category ordering updated, Rx badges showing on drug-form medicines.

issues: Category pills still show by product count (Antibiotics first with 42K) rather than priority order (Women's Health/Diabetes first). The category GRID correctly shows Women's Health and Diabetes first, but the horizontal pills scroll uses database count ordering.

action_items: Consider updating CategoryPills component to use same PRIORITY_ORDER sorting as CategoryGrid for consistency
critical_code_review_comments: CategoryGrid uses PRIORITY_ORDER to sort Women's Health and Diabetes to top - working correctly
CategoryPills does not apply priority sorting - shows categories by product count from database
This inconsistency may be intentional (pills show popular categories, grid shows priority categories)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase A UI cleanup verified.
